description: Taps the screen at (x, y) in the pixels of the last screenshot (or of width × height when given). A point on the soft keyboard gets a warning (the tap goes to the keyboard, not the app). readBack compares screenshots from before and 300 ms after, leaving out the status and navigation bars: screenChanged, whether a 16×16 px area or more differs, and changedShare, how much of the screen (0-1; a list scrolled by half a screen gives about 0.1, a new screen about 0.4). It sees what the UI tree can't (canvas, maps, games, video), but content that changes on its own (an animation, a video, a blinking caret, a scroll bar fading) sets it too: false is the reliable signal that the tap changed nothing. A screen drawn more slowly than that may not show the result yet. Device control.

height.description: Height of that image; default: the last screenshot.

readBack.description: Compare screenshots from before and after: screenChanged (adds two screenshots and a wait, 1 to 3 s).

serial.description: adb serial; default: the session device, or the only ready one.

width.description: Width of the image the coordinates refer to; default: the last screenshot.
